title: Simulations & Agent-Based Modeling with Mesa (PYTH_196_S1 to PYTH_196_S8)

slides.title: Agent-Based Modeling Infrastructure
slides.prompt: Mesa provides framework primitives for constructing agent-based models (ABMs), defining spatial grids, schedulers, and data collectors.

slides.title: Mesa Agent Step Definition
slides.prompt: Fill in the mandatory Agent class method that defines the individual agent's behavior during each simulation tick.

slides.title: Activation Schedulers in Mesa
slides.prompt: What behavior does a `RandomActivation` scheduler enforce when ticking a Mesa simulation model?
options: It invokes the `step` method on all registered agents sequentially in a randomized order each turn
It executes agent steps concurrently using Python multiprocessing threads
It skips agent step calls if system memory utilization exceeds 80%
It evaluates agent actions based on historical creation timestamps
slides.correctAnswer: It invokes the `step` method on all registered agents sequentially in a randomized order each turn

slides.title: Grid Spatial Environments
slides.prompt: Fill in the Mesa spatial grid class that allows multiple agents to occupy the exact same grid coordinate cell.
slides.codeSnippet:
from mesa.space import ___
grid = MultiGrid(width=10, height=10, torus=False)

slides.title: DataCollector Utility
slides.prompt: What is the primary function of the Mesa `DataCollector` class during simulation runs?
options: Tracking and recording model-level and agent-level variables at every step into pandas DataFrames
Exporting 3D geometry objects to CAD file formats
Sending HTTP telemetry reports to external cloud dashboards
slides.correctAnswer: Tracking and recording model-level and agent-level variables at every step into pandas DataFrames

slides.title: Agent Movement on Grids
slides.prompt: Fill in the grid method used to move an agent to new spatial coordinates within a model grid.

slides.title: Torus Spatial Geometry
slides.prompt: What occurs when setting `torus=True` when instantiating a Mesa grid object?
options: Grid edges wrap around seamlessly, connecting top to bottom and left to right boundaries
The grid converts into a 3D spherical projection
Agents are prevented from approaching grid outer boundaries
Grid cells shrink dynamically as agent count increases
slides.correctAnswer: Grid edges wrap around seamlessly, connecting top to bottom and left to right boundaries

slides.title: Model Step Trigger
slides.prompt: Fill in the Model method that advances the simulation timeline by running scheduled agent steps.
